title: CATCH-ME if you RAG: a dataset of Contextually Annotated multi-Turn Counterspeech against Hate and Misinformation Exchanges
reasoning: The paper presents a dataset and benchmark for generating counterspeech against hate speech and misinformation targeting specific religious groups, such as Muslims and Jewish people. It evaluates how models respond to religious stereotypes and includes external knowledge grounded in religious contexts (e.g., references to the Quran and religious practices like the Shahadah).
